question: In Tennis which of the following scores is a complete set?
solution:
The correct answer is __**6-4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Tennis matches work in **three **phases: A game, a set and a match. 
 
• **A game** is played until a player scores four points, which a player can earn in several different ways
 
• **A set** is a collection of games, played until a player wins six games
